newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Foster's eyes new Asian markets.
newsitem.headline: Foster's eyes new Asian markets.

text.p: Foster's Brewing Group Ltd was close to moving into one or two new Asian markets, its chief executive Ted Kunkel said on Monday.
"In Asia, we are close to establishing production in one or two markets and we will be aiming to do so as quickly as possible as part of or broader Asian strategy," Kunkel told a news conference.
Kunkel did not give details of the new markets Foster's aimed to enter.

The group is in the process of establishing marketing and distribution networks for its brewing operations in China which lost A$10.2 million before interest and tax in its first half ended December 31.
Kunkel said Foster's might invest in an existing operator to establish the group in the new Asian markets.
"We know, I believe, what we want to do in each of the markets and that will be direct equity, it will be toll manufacturing, it will be licencing and it will be direct imports," he said.
"In relation to equity participation ... I would like to think that this calendar year we will have that well and truly cleaned up," he added.
